title: Kid-Friendly Spicy Spanish Grana Padano Stew
description: A spicy, comforting Spanish stew made with tender beef, vegetables, and melted grana padano, perfect for kids who love a little heat.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cazuela over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes, until tender.
Add the chorizo and cook for 2 minutes, until browned.
Add the diced tomatoes, beef broth, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the grated Grana Padano cheese and stir until melted and well combined.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the beef is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
